# Anant Sutra Labs

> AI-powered content production studio. Cinematic ads, UGC videos, brand
> films and AI filmmaking. Founder Naveen Sharma — 15 years in animation
> and VFX before moving the studio's production pipeline to AI.

## About

Anant Sutra Labs is led by a 15-year veteran of the animation and VFX
industry, from frame-by-frame craft to full studio productions. Every
AI-generated frame is held to a director's standard: composition,
lighting, pacing, and story sense. The studio did not start as an AI
company that picked up filmmaking — it started as filmmakers who
mastered AI, delivering studio-level judgment at AI-level speed and cost.

## Services

- AI Image Generation — product, fashion, portrait, food and branded visuals
- AI Video Generation — reels, demos, commercials and cinematic films
- AI Voice & Audio — voiceovers, dubbing, jingles and scores
- AI Avatars & Characters — virtual influencers and brand spokespeople
- Motion & Post-Production — graphics, editing, grading and upscaling
- 3D & Product Visualization — 360° spins and multi-angle renders
- Retainer & Recurring Programs — monthly content packages and seasonal bundles

## Portfolio

24 completed films across Mythology, Micro Drama, Commercial and Fashion,
plus one original short film (*The Moon Parcel*) in active development.
Brand-name commercials in the reel (Cheetos, Diet Coke, Royal Enfield,
etc.) are independent concept work created to demonstrate craft — not
commissioned by, affiliated with, or endorsed by the brands depicted.
